units.source_text: “是呵，那当然，可这只是作为一个例子呀……

en.t: Yes, of course, but this is only meant as an example...

units.source_text: 按沙子的特性，难道就不能考虑搞一些特殊的农作物吗？

en.t: Given the properties of the sand, couldn't you consider growing some special crops?

units.source_text: ……总而言之，我是说没有必要硬撑着，拘泥于这种老式的生活……”

en.t: ...In short, what I mean is that there is no need to stubbornly hold out and cling to this old-fashioned way of life...
